title: NS Client "Follower"/"Remote User" - "No profile set" warning - Not possible to activate any profile
body:
I'm using NSClient version 3.1.0.3 as a follower to my sons AAPS.

I changed my mobile (same no.) and had to re-install NSClient. After installation process the "no profile set" error came up and I can't do anything about it. I already tried to load/reset/create a local profile - no chance. Trying to activate a profile always does nothing. Additionally no treatments are possible from the mobile and all buttons for insulin, bolus, etc. on front page are missing, although set up in the settings.

My phone is Android 13 , Pixel 7 Pro, if this is of any importance/help.

Only thing that's working is the readings of current Nightscout values.
